[.walkthrough]
.What's in the menu
. Click *⋮* at the end of the toolbar. The top of the menu shows your Vaadin account and messages, such as tips for your development setup and the release notes of a new version.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/01-open.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/01-open.jpg"]
. *App Info* lists what your application runs on: the Vaadin, Java and Spring versions, and whether you have set up hot swap and the IDE plugin.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/02-app-info.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/02-app-info.jpg"]
. *App Log* shows the communication between your application and its backend services, its errors, and Copilot's notifications.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/03-app-log.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/03-app-log.jpg"]
. *Features* turns feature flags on and off, for your application and for Copilot.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/04-features.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/04-features.jpg"]
. *Feedback* sends general feedback, a bug report, a question, or an idea to Vaadin.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/05-feedback.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/05-feedback.jpg"]
. *Settings* changes how Copilot looks and behaves, such as its size, theme, and how the toolbar appears.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/06-settings.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/menu/06-settings.jpg"]
